compatibility.dynamic.conjunction: You are the same sign. You recognise each other on sight and you share exactly the same blind spot, which means nobody in this pairing is going to be the adult about it.
compatibility.dynamic.opposition: You are the two ends of one axis. Everything you are missing, they are carrying — which is magnetic right up until it is the thing you fight about.
compatibility.dynamic.quincunx: Neither of you is wrong. You are running different software. Nearly all the damage in this pairing comes from deciding the other one is being difficult on purpose.
compatibility.dynamic.semiSextile: You sit next to each other on the wheel and have almost nothing in common. That is survivable. It just has to be chosen on purpose, over and over, rather than assumed.
compatibility.dynamic.sextile: This one is easy, and you may not trust it for exactly that reason. Somewhere along the way you were taught that real meant difficult. It does not.
compatibility.dynamic.square: There is friction here, and the friction is the attraction. You will not be bored. You will also have the same argument more than once before either of you admits it is the same one.
compatibility.dynamic.trine: You run on the same operating system. Things other people have to negotiate, the two of you will simply never need to discuss — which is its own risk, because unexamined is not the same as agreed.
compatibility.element.air+air: Two air signs. Endless conversation, and a shared talent for never quite having the difficult one.
compatibility.element.air+water: You explain feelings and they feel them. Translation is the work here, and it has to go both ways or it becomes a job.
compatibility.element.earth+air: One of you wants it decided and the other wants it discussed. That gap is not a phase. It is the relationship.
compatibility.element.earth+earth: Two earth signs. Unshowy, unhurried, and far harder to break than it looks from outside.
compatibility.element.earth+water: Water needs a bank to run along, and it has found one. This is the quietly durable pairing nobody makes films about.
compatibility.element.fire+air: Air feeds fire. This is the pairing that starts things. The open question is which of you finishes them.
compatibility.element.fire+earth: One of you moves and one of you builds. It works right up until the builder gets treated as the brake.
compatibility.element.fire+fire: Two fires. Bright, fast, and nobody in the house remembers to eat.
compatibility.element.fire+water: Fire and water. One of you burns it off, the other holds it. Neither of those is the wrong way to survive something.
compatibility.element.water+water: Two water signs. You will always know what the other is feeling, including the parts you would both rather skip.
compatibility.lopsided: One of you has already told their friends.
compatibility.power.even: Neither of you is running this, which sounds unremarkable and is the reason it might last.
compatibility.power.them: They set the terms. You will lose most of the arguments, and you will not always notice that you have.
compatibility.power.you: You set the terms here. They agreed to them a while ago, probably without either of you discussing it.
compatibility.pull.even: You want this about equally — which is genuinely the rarest result on this page.
compatibility.pull.them: They are further into this than you are, and both of you can feel it even if neither has said so.
compatibility.pull.you: You want this more than they do. That is not a flaw, but it is a fact, and pretending otherwise is where the trouble starts.
compatibility.punchline.depth: Neither of you walks away clean.
compatibility.punchline.drama: You will have this argument again.
compatibility.punchline.spark: The chemistry was never the problem.
compatibility.share.sextile: Easy — and neither of us trusts easy.
compatibility.watch.depth: This stays light. That is fine, as long as light is what you both actually came for.
compatibility.watch.drama: Nothing here will force anything into the open. This can drift for a year before either of you admits that it has.
compatibility.watch.future: This runs hot and can burn down to nothing. The work is having a version of it that holds on an ordinary Tuesday.
compatibility.watch.spark: The heat has to be fed on purpose. Comfortable is not the same as over, but left alone long enough the two look identical.
compatibility.watch.trust: Reassurance has to be said out loud, and then said again, past the point either of you thinks it should still be necessary.
compatibility.watch.vibe: You are at your best when something is happening. Empty afternoons are where this one actually gets tested.
compatibility.works.depth: This goes deep fast. Neither of you will be able to explain it accurately to a friend, and you will both try.
compatibility.works.drama: Nothing about this is boring. You will remember it whichever way it goes, which is more than most people get.
compatibility.works.future: This one survives being ordinary — the only test that actually matters, and the one most pairings quietly fail.
compatibility.works.spark: The chemistry is not in question. Whatever else the two of you have to work out, you will never have to manufacture wanting each other.
compatibility.works.trust: Neither of you has to perform safety here. It is simply present, and it is the rarest thing on this page.
compatibility.works.vibe: The ordinary days are good. Almost everybody underrates that until they have had the alternative.
energy.finding: Your energy runs lowest around the {lowest} — {count} check-ins say so — and highest around the {highest}.
reading.commitment.daily: Every morning. That was your word, not ours.
reading.commitment.most: Most days. Enough to build something.
reading.commitment.when: When you need it. It will be here either way.
reading.intention.calm: Your readings will be quiet on purpose. Less to think about, not more.
reading.intention.clarity: Your readings will keep returning you to the decision, until you stop circling it and make it.
reading.intention.love: Your readings will be written toward the people in your life — the ones you are trying to understand, and the one you are trying to become for them.
reading.intention.people: Your readings will be about the people around you, and what they are doing that you keep explaining away.
reading.intention.purpose: Your readings will stay on the long shape of it, not the noise of any particular week.
reading.intention.self: Your readings will tell you things about yourself that you already suspect and have not said out loud.
reading.opening.air: You live half a step ahead of the room, already three moves into a conversation nobody has started yet.
reading.opening.earth: You need the ground to hold before you put weight on it. People read that as slowness. It is not slowness.
reading.opening.fire: You move first and understand it afterwards. It has cost you things, and it has also been the only reason anything started.
reading.opening.water: You feel the temperature of a room before anyone speaks. You have been told this is too much. It is not too much.
reading.recognition.drained: You have been pouring out of a cup that nobody has refilled, and calling the emptiness a character flaw.
reading.recognition.letting_go: You are still carrying something that finished a while ago. Not because you are weak about it, but because nobody ever told you when you were allowed to put it down.
reading.recognition.mixed_signals: You are trying to read someone who is not being clear, and calling your confusion a failure of intuition. It is not. They are being unclear.
reading.recognition.racing: Your mind is moving faster than your day actually requires. The speed is not the problem. Having nowhere to put it is.
reading.recognition.repeating: You can already describe the pattern. That is the part people miss — you are not stuck because you cannot see it. You are stuck because seeing it was supposed to be enough.
reading.recognition.stuck: You are waiting to feel ready. Ready is something that arrives afterwards, which is an unfair way for it to work, and it is still how it works.
transit.headline: {transiting} {verb} {natal}
transit.opener.conjunction: These two are sitting on top of each other today.
transit.opener.opposition: You are being pulled two ways at once.
transit.opener.sextile: There is a quiet opening here.
transit.opener.square: Today has an edge to it.
transit.opener.trine: This one is easy, if you let it be.
transit.pair.jupiter.mars: Your appetite outruns your judgement today and mostly gets away with it. Mostly.
transit.pair.jupiter.saturn: The slow thing you have been building gets a little more room. Not a breakthrough — a door left open.
transit.pair.jupiter.sun: The room is wider today. Ask for the thing you decided last month was too much to ask for.
transit.pair.jupiter.venus: Generosity comes easily today, including toward yourself. Enjoy it. Do not sign anything.
transit.pair.mars.saturn: Pushing on the locked door is the temptation today. The door is not the problem; the wall beside it is thinner than it looks.
transit.pair.mars.sun: Something will need doing and you are the one who does it. Move early — the day gets less patient as it goes on.
transit.pair.mars.venus: You will want something and you will not be patient about it. That is not a flaw today, but it is a fact.
transit.pair.mercury.mars: You will win the argument. Consider, briefly, whether you want to.
transit.pair.mercury.saturn: The thought you keep circling will not resolve by being thought about again. Write it down, or say it to somebody.
transit.pair.mercury.sun: You will explain yourself today, probably more than once. The version you arrive at on the third attempt is the true one.
transit.pair.mercury.venus: Say the nice thing out loud. You have been assuming it was obvious, and it is not obvious.
transit.pair.saturn.mars: Your drive meets a wall this week, and the wall wins on points. Whatever survives that is the part worth keeping.
transit.pair.saturn.sun: This is one of the seasons that makes you. It will not feel like that while it is happening. It never does.
transit.pair.saturn.venus: Something you love is being asked to be real rather than lovely. That is not the same as it going wrong.
transit.pair.sun.mars: Your temper is nearer the surface than usual, and so is your nerve. Spend the second one before the first one spends you.
transit.pair.sun.saturn: Today asks whether you meant it — not dramatically, just in the small moment where you decide whether to do the thing you said you would.
transit.pair.sun.venus: The light is on what you want. Whatever you have been calling a preference is going to look a lot more like a need by this evening.
transit.pair.venus.mars: Wanting something and going after it line up today. That is rarer than it sounds, and it does not last.
transit.pair.venus.saturn: Affection today arrives with a condition attached. It is yours, not theirs, and it is worth knowing which one.
transit.pair.venus.sun: You are easier to be around today, and you will notice people responding to it before you notice why.
transit.quietDay: The sky is not doing anything to you today. Those days exist, and they are the ones things actually get finished on.
transit.retrograde.jupiter: Jupiter is retrograde. The growth is inward this time, which is less fun and considerably more useful.
transit.retrograde.mars: Mars is retrograde. Effort travels sideways rather than forward for a while. Push anyway if you must, but expect the angle.
transit.retrograde.mercury: Mercury is retrograde. Everything you send gets read twice — once by them, and once by you at two in the morning.
transit.retrograde.saturn: Saturn is retrograde. The thing you thought you had settled is asking to be settled properly.
transit.retrograde.venus: Venus is retrograde. Old names resurface. Answering is optional.
transit.retrogradeRerun: And it is retrograde, so this is a rerun — you have met this one before.
